# Heriteo

> Heriteo is a digital heritage management platform that helps families catalog their heirlooms and estate assets, plan inheritance distribution among heirs, and preserve the stories behind each item — all in one organized, private place.

Heriteo is an estate planning app and family heirloom inventory tool that transforms how families approach legacy preservation. The platform provides a structured, intuitive workflow covering every step of estate management: from photographing and cataloging objects to assigning them to heirs and capturing the memories attached to each piece. It is a practical alternative to spreadsheet-based inheritance planning and paper asset lists.

Key differentiators:
- End-to-end workflow from cataloging to heir distribution planning
- Story and emotional context capture alongside each asset
- Dynamic album collections with tag and room-based auto-filtering
- Heir intention tracking with conflict resolution tools
- Family collaboration with per-plan user limits
- Real-time updates across all family members via SSE
- Free during early access — no credit card required

## Product Features

- [Asset Catalog](https://myheriteo.com/assets): Build a comprehensive digital inventory of family heirlooms and estate objects with photos, descriptions, tags, condition records, and valuations — the core of any estate inventory app
- [Heir Intentions](https://myheriteo.com/assets): Assign inheritance wishes to each asset — keep, gift to a specific heir, sell, or donate — with configurable decision strength; prevents inheritance disputes
- [Stories & Legacy](https://myheriteo.com/assets): Attach narratives to objects: personal memories, provenance, ownership history, and location stories to preserve family history alongside physical objects
- [Albums](https://myheriteo.com/assets): Curate photo collections manually or via dynamic filters (by tag and room) to group and share heritage assets
- [Dashboard & Review](https://myheriteo.com/overview): Track cataloging progress, review heir assignments, and identify coverage gaps across the entire estate
- [Family Workspace](https://myheriteo.com/workspace-users): Invite family members, manage roles, and collaborate on the shared estate inventory

## Target Markets

- [Families Managing Heritage](https://heriteo.com/about): Multi-generational families seeking an organized heirloom catalog and fair inheritance distribution plan
- [Estate Executors & Planners](https://heriteo.com/about): Attorneys, notaries, and financial advisors guiding clients through estate management and inheritance processes
- [Individuals with Collections](https://heriteo.com/about): Collectors of antiques, art, jewelry, or family memorabilia wanting a structured digital archive with valuation tracking
